segments: Over a shot of palm trees against a sunset, the title card "Hollow" appears.
The view tilts down. The top of a pumpkin appears, moving down a path in a park while people walk nearby.

The pumpkin is revealed to be connected to a person dressed like a man and is attached to his body where the head would normally be. He sits alone on a bench in front of a large fountain, feeding the birds.
The pumpkin person walks alongside a fence outside a tennis court. There's a girl playing inside who hasn't noticed him yet.
The tennis girl looks judgmentally and fearfully at him before turning back to her tennis game.
The pumpkin person's face is carved into a downcast expression and he looks down and away from the tennis girl.
The pumpkin person sits alone on the bus, sadly looking outside. His expression brightens slightly when he looks over.
He turns out to be looking at the tennis girl, who is on her phone and ignoring him.
He sadly looks back out the window and rests his head against the bus. The screen cuts to black.
